Show less Read more Like 1 Dislike Reply Comments 13 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam In this video Transcript Description Live: SpaceX Falcon 9 launches 29 Starlink satellites on North-East trajectory from Cape Canaveral Watch live coverage as SpaceX launches a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 29 satellites for Elon Musk's Starlink internet service. Liftoff from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is scheduled for Tuesday, March 17, at 9:27 a.m. EDT (1327 UTC). The first-stage booster for this mission, 1090, launching for an 11th time, will land on SpaceX's drone ship 'A Shortfall of Gravitas', stationed in the Atlantic Ocean, roughly 8.5 minutes after leaving the launch pad. The mission, designated Starlink 10-46, will take a north-easterly trajectory on departure from Florida's Space Coast. Our live coverage with commentary from Spaceflight Now's Will Robinson-Smith will start about one hour prior to launch. Videos like this are made possible by the support of our members.
